mission_06: Start with mobile styles as the default, then use @media (min-width: 768px) for tablet and @media (min-width: 1024px) for desktop.
At the tablet breakpoint, show the nav menu (display: block) and hide the hamburger (display: none).
Increase grid columns at each breakpoint: 1 column on mobile, 2 on tablet, 3 on desktop.
